data.one_liner: A package to bootstrap bloc state management for network queries and mutations.
data.what_it_does: It helps reduce boilerplate when building blocs or cubits for network requests by providing pre-defined states and state transitions for both queries and mutations. It is fully compatible with flutter_bloc widgets and APIs.
use_when: You are already using the bloc ecosystem and want standardized states for network requests.
You want to manage query-like or mutation-like network operations with pre-defined states.
avoid_when: You are using a different state management solution like Riverpod or Provider.
You do not want to use the bloc architecture for your network calls.
strengths: Reduces boilerplate for network-related blocs and cubits.
Provides built-in query and mutation handling classes.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the bloc state management library.
Opinionated structure that may not fit every custom networking requirement.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to implement custom state management solutions without the opinionated network helpers.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Often used alongside bloc packages for widget binding.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer an alternative reactive state management library over bloc.
